response.text:
The first release of pytest on PyPI was in 2010, as indicated by the earliest year in its release history. The first release of ruff on PyPI was in 2022, as shown in its release history. The difference between these years is 2022 - 2010 = 12 years. 

ANSWER: pytest was first released in 2010, ruff in 2022, and they are 12 years apart.
